main_body: Flat-roofed desert house: a large roof terrace with a parapet, a rug and a hatch, above a south wall with an arched door and a barred window
top_band: Roof surface, light sand tone (L≈175, with 202 highlights) at rows 4-31 of column x=32, inside a parapet rim at rows 1-3. It ends in a lighter front-edge line at rows 28-30, then a dark eave row at 32-33.
evidence: Column x=32 meets a large light horizontal roof, then a lighter front-edge line (L=202 at rows 28 and 30). Below that are a dark eave and shadow (L=96 at row 32, L=70 at row 33) and the darker wall face (L≈122 from row 34). The roof is tall, but the rug, hatch and parapet read clearly as a horizontal surface seen from above. The wall is a separate vertical face with an arched door in a pale frame and an inset barred window. No receding side face appears. It reads as a correct flat-roof 3/4 building.
